nodes.text: A supplier submission is disposed of only on checked evidence, by someone authorised to decide, leaving a record that reconstructs the decision.

Argue over the five ways a disposal can be wrong: a violation is approved, an unchecked finding is believed, the wrong person decides, the record cannot reconstruct what happened, or every check passes against reference data that was itself wrong.
Scope: one hermetic reference runner over recurring service-provider billing submissions. Contracts, rate cards, POs and registers are fixtures held in this process, not live integrations.
The committee's three personas are scripted, deterministic roles. No model is called, so nothing here is evidence about model behaviour.
The reviewer at the gate reads what the package shows them. Every controllability grade in the hazard log rests on this.
A submission that fails an arithmetic or contract check cannot be approved, and the same invoice cannot be approved twice.
resume() refuses an approval while failures remain; the case must be corrected or rejected. Exercised by test_hard_rule_failure_cannot_be_overridden.
Covers this runner's fourteen checks. A check that is not implemented cannot fail, and so cannot block.
The supplier-and-invoice identity is checked against an approved-invoice register before approval is possible. Exercised by test_contract_failures_drive_rejection.

The register lives in memory for the length of one run. Across two processes — or one restart — it sees nothing, so in a deployment this control is effectively absent until a durable shared register replaces it. This is the widest gap in the log and the first thing an integration has to close.
No finding reaches the reviewer that was not rebuilt from evidence the runner checked itself.
A verified finding is rebuilt from the checked evidence; the proposal's own wording is discarded. Exercised by test_verified_finding_is_restated_from_evidence_not_proposal_prose.
Only a computed volume variance is admissible. Any other finding type is dropped rather than verified — the runner cannot check it, so it does not carry it.
Free text never reaches the proposal adapter or the decision; the proposer is handed a revalidated submission with the note removed. Exercised by test_supplier_note_never_reaches_proposal_adapter.
The instruction-pattern detector is two signatures and is not a comprehensive injection detector. Structural exclusion is what holds, not detection.
An adapter that raises or exceeds its budget forfeits every proposal, and the case still reaches the gate. Exercised by test_failing_proposal_adapter_forfeits_findings_and_reaches_the_gate.
Bounds the blast radius of a bad proposer; it does not make the proposer trustworthy.
Only a reviewer on the configured allowlist can record a decision, and an unauthorised attempt changes nothing.
An explicit Awaiting_reviewer state plus a reviewer allowlist; an unauthorised resume raises and mutates nothing. Exercised by test_gate_prevents_archive_and_unauthorised_decision.

The allowlist is a set held by this process. The mechanism — an explicit authorisation check that mutates nothing on failure — transfers to a deployment; the identity behind it does not, and a session or delegation model would have to supply it.
The record reconstructs what was claimed, what was checked and who decided — including across a correction.

A correction must keep the case and invoice identity and increase its version; earlier events stay in the record and every check runs again. Exercised by test_correction_revalidates_and_keeps_original_events.
Records are held in memory for the run. Durable custody, retention and tamper evidence are integration responsibilities.
The test count is recorded against a digest of the supplier sources and is withdrawn from the page when the digest stops matching. Exercised by test_scenarios_are_reproducible_and_attributable.
Covers the supplier sources only. It detects a stale figure; it does not detect a test that passes for the wrong reason.
The contract, rate card, PO and spending limit a submission is checked against are themselves correct and current.

Nothing in this runner checks the reference data. Every arithmetic and contract check is exact against whatever contract, rate card and limit it was handed, so a stale rate card or a superseded PO produces a correct-looking approval against the wrong terms, and no control here would notice. Closing this needs a source of truth for contract data and a currency check against it — neither of which is in scope for a reference runner, which is why the branch is drawn undeveloped rather than argued.

note: Goal Structuring Notation, with defeaters from eliminative argumentation. Goals are authored; every solution and defeater is derived from the hazard log, so the argument cannot claim coverage the hazards do not have.
